_meta.description: Project-level skill registry. Lists skills enabled for this project with governance metadata.

schema.name: string — skill name from _rag_index
schema.path: string — SKILL.md path relative to toolBox
schema.enabledReason: string — why this skill is enabled for this project
schema.lastUsed: string|null — ISO timestamp of last use
schema.effectiveness: string|null — actual effectiveness assessment after use
